sinopsis.es: Documental de metraje encontrado sobre una gira de 1995: presentaciones en vivo, entrevistas francas y la vida detrás de escena con los Beastie Boys, Sonic Youth, Foo Fighters, Beck, Pavement, Rancid, The Amps y Bikini Kill.
sinopsis.en: A found footage documentary from a concert tour in 1995 that features live performances, candid interviews and a behind the scene view of what it's like to be on tour with the Beastie Boys, Sonic Youth, Foo Fighters, Beck, Pavement, Rancid, The Amps and Bikini Kill.
